title: Hong Kong 100 – Entry and ballot (2027)
claims: The Hong Kong Government imposes participant limits of 1,800 for HK100, 500 for The Half and 500 for The Third.
Everyone wishing to take part must enter through the ballot, except past winners, 2026 volunteers, runners who joined all 16 years of the race from 2011 to 2026, and sponsor nominees.
Ballot results for the 2027 edition will be released on Monday 17 August 2026.
Selected entrants must complete full registration by Sunday 23 August 2026.
Unclaimed places will be reallocated from Monday 31 August 2026.
Runners may register solo or as a pair, and each person may register for one distance only and only once for that distance.
